title: Exactly Fifteen Seconds of Music

turns.text: I need a music bed that's exactly 15 seconds, no vocals. Style is up to you.

tests: Checks whether the agent delivers one continuous, exactly 15-second music file despite the per-clip generation limit, rather than substituting a shorter clip or separate parts.

answer_sheet.Output: One continuous standalone audio file, not separate clips.

must_haves: One playable audio file is delivered, not multiple separate music segments.
The decoded audio duration is 15.00 seconds, within 0.05 second.
Music fills the duration rather than padding a shorter track with a long silence.
No singing or spoken words are audible.
Any internal joins are musically smooth, without clicks, gaps or jarring changes in tempo or sound.
